title: Interior Secretary Announces New Ayotzinapa Report With Fresh Investigation Lines
detail: Interior Secretary Rosa Icela Rodríguez told President Sheinbaum's September 3, 2026 morning press conference that the government would present a comprehensive new report on the Ayotzinapa case, jointly prepared by the human rights subsecretariat (Arturo Medina) and the case's specialized prosecutor. Rodríguez said new methodologies and field investigation had produced elements for new investigative lines and detentions of individuals not previously under investigation, stating there would be 'no impunity and no one is above the law.' Sheinbaum reiterated the report would be delivered before September 26, 2026 — the twelfth anniversary of the students' disappearance — following the August 6 detention of former Guerrero governor Ángel Aguirre.
